description:
Site-wide totals and data freshness. The headline numbers from the servers.rustprofit.com homepage: `online_servers`, `total_players` and
`queued_players` summed across every online server, `tracked_servers` (every row ever discovered, offline
included), `steam_global_players` (Rust's concurrent player count from Steam, null if Steam did not answer),
`next_force_wipe_at` (the first Thursday of the month at 2 PM US Eastern: 18:00 UTC during US daylight saving time, 19:00 UTC otherwise), the poller's
configuration (`poll_interval_seconds` between cycles, `offline_after_seconds` before an unanswering server
is marked offline, `snapshot_retention_days` of per-server history kept) and `workers` - the live heartbeat
status of the discovery, polling and map-generation jobs, so you can tell how fresh the data is. Includes next_force_wipe_at (Rust's monthly forced wipe).
name: get_server_stats
title: Site-wide totals and data freshness
